stack_liftoff_mass_t.note: Derived: booster dry 275 t + booster prop 3400 t + ship dry ~100 t + ship prop 1500 t (no payload). Published figures range ~5000 t (SpaceX 'about 5000 t') to 5500 t (Flight 7 reporting incl. hot-stage ring/payload); ship dry quoted 85-120 t. 6% band spans 4960-5590 t.

liftoff_thrust_MN.note: 33 x Raptor 2 @ 230 tf = 7590 tf = 74.43 MN (SpaceX site value). Wikipedia lists 73.5 MN max for Block 1/2; 3% covers both.

liftoff_TW.note: 7590 tf / stack mass. Liftoff mass uncertainty (5000-5500 t) gives 1.38-1.52; +/-0.1 absolute.

raptor_sl_isp_s.note: Raptor 2 sea-level Isp 327 s widely cited; SpaceX has not published an exact number; +/-3 s.

raptor_sl_thrust_kN.note: SpaceX: Raptor 2 = 230 tf (2255.5 kN). Tight: this is an official SpaceX number.

ship_dv_vac_100t_payload_ms.note: Rocket eq. Isp 380 s, m0 = 100 dry + 1500 prop + 100 payload, mf = 200 t -> ~7975 m/s. Ship dry 85-120 t and blended Isp (3 SL Raptors ~350 s vac + 3 RVac) move this 7500-8300 m/s; +/-600 m/s.

booster_full_throttle_burn_time_s.note: 3400 t / (33 x 2255.5 kN / (327 s x g0)) = ~146.5 s (all prop, full throttle). Real flights MECO at ~155-165 s with throttling and boostback reserve (IFT telemetry); 15% band.

ship_prop_mass_t.note: Block 2 ship propellant 1500 t (SpaceX/Wikipedia; Block 1 was 1200 t). 5%.

booster_prop_mass_t.note: Super Heavy Block 1/2 propellant 3400 t (SpaceX site). 5%.
